html:
Question 11
?

The first term of a geometric sequence is 6 and the common ratio is −4. Written in sigma notation, what is the sum of the first 32 terms?

a
∑n=132(−23)(−4)n
b
∑n=13223(−4)n
c
∑n=13234(−2)n
d
∑n=132(−32)(−4)n
e
∑n=132(−23)(−2)n
Submit
